name: Kysucké Nové Mesto (Slovakia)
description: Six equal horizontal stripes of green, green, white, white, green and green, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature K-9/1991.
